domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 轮轨滚动接触激励引起的噪声。
usage_overview: 作为轮轨噪声预测与极值响应估计的研究对象，关注轮轨粗糙度激发结构振动后产生的噪声；在计入车轮、钢轨和轨道板的模型中，考察各结构的噪声贡献。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Vol.:(0123456789) ORIGINAL ARTICLE A novel method for extremum response estimation of wheel–rail rolling noise by the development of moving pseudo‐excitation method Zixu Zhu1 · Qingyuan Xu1 · Lei Xu1 © Wroclaw University of Science and Technology 2023 Abstract Wheel–rail rolling noise (WRRN) hold strong randomicity and time-varying time–frequency characteristics subjected to a moving vehicle on the tracks, consequently, its prediction highly depends on accurate simulation and calibration of vehicle– track interaction and noise source.
This model is extended and developed from the Remington model [5, 6], which is the earliest wheel–rail rolling noise prediction model.
